NOW: THAT SURFACE SHUT DOWN, March 2026 —

 applicability. Verify live terms. Do NOT put it
 in a business case." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="80" width="460" x="20" y="176" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="g4" parent="chg" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="NOW: Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect (8 Apr 2026)
 is a PROTOCOL-AGNOSTIC on-ramp" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="24" width="460" x="20" y="266" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="tension" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffdf5;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="THE TENSION THAT DECIDES HOW MUCH TO BUILD

McKinsey, US agentic commerce by 2030 $1 TRILLION
Shoppers using agents to buy today ~1%
NRF 2026 retailers implementing it 75%
Adobe: genAI traffic to US retail sites +4,700% YoY

"Infrastructure is way ahead of consumers."

→ "INSTRUMENT AGENT TRANSACTION FLOWS NOW,
 WHILE VOLUMES ARE LOW ENOUGH TO DEBUG PROPERLY."

This is a READINESS play, not a revenue play —
and readiness is cheap while volume is near zero." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="290" width="500" x="40" y="420" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="stack" parent="1" style="swimlane;startSize=34;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontStyle=1;fontSize=12;fontColor=#3d7a2a;" value="The stack" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="620" width="580" x="590" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s0" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#dae8fc;strokeColor=#6c8ebf;fontSize=11;" value="External agents: ChatGPT · Gemini · Claude · procurement bots
 + the Visa ICC on-ramp" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="46" width="540" x="20" y="44" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s1" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;" value="DISCOVERY /.well-known/agent-card.json · /.well-known/ucp" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="36" width="540" x="20" y="100" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s2" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="PROTOCOL SURFACE (ecommerce-bff)
ACP (REST) checkout_sessions · complete · cancel · webhooks
UCP (A2A JSON-RPC) agent cart · catalogue · IDENTITY LINKING for loyalty
MCP browse-before-buy — ai-service tools, ALREADY BUILT" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="76" width="540" x="20" y="146" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s3" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#ffe6cc;strokeColor=#d79b00;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="AP2 CONSENT LAYER — the part set-1 idea 03 did not have

three signed MANDATES as W3C Verifiable Credentials:
 INTENT what the user authorised the agent to do
 CART what the agent actually assembled
 PAYMENT the funding instrument and its limits

verify the chain BEFORE fulfilling. Stablecoin rails first-class." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="118" width="540" x="20" y="232" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s4" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#d5e8d4;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;fontStyle=1" value="ONE ADAPTER LAYER → ONE internal AgenticCheckoutSession
protocol churn costs ONE FILE, not a service" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="50" width="540" x="20" y="360" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s5" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#e1d5e7;strokeColor=#9673a6;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;" value="validate SKUs → price for channel AGENT → promotion engine negotiates
→ reserve stock → payment → order (orderType = AGENT)
Existing services, unchanged. Nothing forked, no fast path." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="66" width="540" x="20" y="420" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="s6" parent="stack" style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fff2cc;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=8;fontStyle=1" value="INSTRUMENTATION FIRST — every agent interaction into ai_decision (I06)
+ OTel spans. The funnel: discovery → session → cart → mandate verified
→ complete, with failure reasons BY PROTOCOL.
This is the artefact worth having while volumes are 1%." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="86" width="540" x="20" y="496" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="opa" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f3faf1;strokeColor=#82b366;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontFamily=Courier New;" value="The OPA gate matters more here than anywhere

An autonomous agent holding a payment token is the
highest-consequence caller we will ever expose.

allow if {
 input.principal.type == "agent"
 input.action == "complete_checkout"
 input.cart.total &lt;= input.mandate.payment.limit # AP2 Payment
 input.cart.items ⊆ input.mandate.cart.items # AP2 Cart
 input.mandate.intent.verified == true # AP2 Intent
 input.cart.total &lt;= input.session.budgetRemaining
}

THE MANDATE CHAIN BECOMES POLICY INPUT.
Cryptographically-signed consent, enforced by a policy
engine that already runs in production. That is the slide." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="330" width="540" x="1220" y="90" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="new" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#fffdf5;strokeColor=#d6b656;fontSize=11;align=left;spacingLeft=10;verticalAlign=top;spacingTop=8;fontStyle=1" value="A genuinely NEW capability, not just compliance

An Intent / Cart / Payment mandate chain is BETTER
EVIDENCE OF CONSENT than anything we have for a
human checkout.

Verify it, store it against the order, and use it for
DISPUTE HANDLING.

Human checkout gives us a session log.
Agent checkout gives us a signed credential chain." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="260" width="540" x="1220" y="450" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="foot" parent="1" style="rounded=0;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;fillColor=#f9f9f9;strokeColor=#999999;fontSize=12;align=left;spacingLeft=12;verticalAlign=middle;dashed=1;" value="Acceptance rails exist and are NOT competing protocols: Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect (protocol-agnostic, 8 Apr 2026) · Mastercard Agent Pay · Amex ACE (first consumer-protection programme for agentic commerce).
Governance is consolidating: an Agentic Authentication Technical Working Group chaired by CVS Health, Google and OpenAI, with vice-chairs from Amazon and Okta. Merchant signal: Gap + Google, with Gap's CTO saying UCP gives merchants MORE CONTROL than ACP.
Structural risk named in the sources: proprietary agents inside Amazon, OpenAI or Google could fragment the ecosystem. Our answer is open standards plus one internal model — a proprietary surface then costs one more adapter.
Phase 1 alone (7 days) — a normalised internal model plus instrumentation — is the defensible minimum, and it is exactly what the market guidance says to do first." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry div.div:
INSTRUMENTATION FIRST — every agent interaction into ai_decision (I06)
+ OTel spans. The funnel: discovery → session → cart → mandate verified
→ complete, with failure reasons BY PROTOCOL.
This is the artefact worth having while volumes are 1%.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(243, 250, 241), rgb(20, 26, 18)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(130, 179, 102), rgb(68, 110, 44));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 528px; height: 1px; padding-top: 85px; margin-left: 1192px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Courier New'; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
The OPA gate matters more here than anywhere
An autonomous agent holding a payment token is the
highest-consequence caller we will ever expose.
allow if {
input.principal.type == "agent"
input.action == "complete_checkout"
input.cart.total <= input.mandate.payment.limit # AP2 Payment
input.cart.items ⊆ input.mandate.cart.items # AP2 Cart
input.mandate.intent.verified == true # AP2 Intent
input.cart.total <= input.session.budgetRemaining
}
THE MANDATE CHAIN BECOMES POLICY INPUT.
Cryptographically-signed consent, enforced by a policy
engine that already runs in production. That is the slide.

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(255, 253, 245), rgb(22, 20, 14)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(214, 182, 86), rgb(109, 81, 0));

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe flex-start; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 528px; height: 1px; padding-top: 445px; margin-left: 1192px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 11px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; font-weight: bold; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
A genuinely NEW capability, not just compliance
An Intent / Cart / Payment mandate chain is BETTER
EVIDENCE OF CONSENT than anything we have for a
human checkout.
Verify it, store it against the order, and use it for
DISPUTE HANDLING.
Human checkout gives us a session log.
Agent checkout gives us a signed credential chain.

div.style: display: flex; align-items: unsafe center; justify-content: unsafe flex-start; width: 1706px; height: 1px; padding-top: 800px; margin-left: 14px;
box-sizing: border-box; font-size: 0; text-align: left; color: #000000;
display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, #ffffff); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
Acceptance rails exist and are NOT competing protocols: Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect (protocol-agnostic, 8 Apr 2026) · Mastercard Agent Pay · Amex ACE (first consumer-protection programme for agentic commerce).
Governance is consolidating: an Agentic Authentication Technical Working Group chaired by CVS Health, Google and OpenAI, with vice-chairs from Amazon and Okta. Merchant signal: Gap + Google, with Gap's CTO saying UCP gives merchants MORE CONTROL than ACP.
Structural risk named in the sources: proprietary agents inside Amazon, OpenAI or Google could fragment the ecosystem. Our answer is open standards plus one internal model — a proprietary surface then costs one more adapter.
Phase 1 alone (7 days) — a normalised internal model plus instrumentation — is the defensible minimum, and it is exactly what the market guidance says to do first.
